dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you mean by that?

dialogues.speaker: Shchukina
dialogues.text: For example, have you forgotten to take something with you when you leave the house? Then missed your train after you went back for it? Or maybe you lost your job after fouling up a deal or something. It all sounds pretty ordinary, doesn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Shchukina
dialogues.text: Has anything unlucky happened to you recently?
